aiSummary.oneLiner: A free, open-source instant messaging and VoIP platform designed for friends, groups, and large communities.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Fluxer is a highly capable open-source communication platform positioned as a direct alternative to commercial chat applications like Discord. It provides robust infrastructure for instant messaging, group organization, and high-quality Voice over IP (VoIP) capabilities tailored for large communities. The project places a heavy emphasis on trust and safety, recently implementing comprehensive safety infrastructure to combat spam while simultaneously refining its audio and video systems. By releasing Canary client builds, it allows users to aggressively test its latest features across desktop and web environments while finalizing the core open-source codebase for self-hosting.
keyFeatures: High-Quality VoIP: Integrates advanced audio and video systems to support real-time voice channels and video conferencing for large groups.
Community Organization: Provides granular server and channel structures allowing administrators to effectively organize thousands of community members.
Open Source Core: Commits to transparency by actively working to release its full API and backend infrastructure for independent self-hosting.
Trust and Safety Infrastructure: Incorporates dedicated systems specifically designed to mitigate spam waves and protect community integrity.
Canary Build Access: Offers experimental web and desktop clients so users can test cutting-edge features before they hit the stable release channel.
Cross-Platform Availability: Ensures users can seamlessly connect via dedicated desktop applications or directly through a web browser interface.

useCases.title: Community Moderation
useCases.description: Server administrators leverage the new trust and safety infrastructure to automatically filter out spam waves targeting their large open-source community.

useCases.title: Secure Self-Hosting
useCases.description: Privacy-focused organizations utilize the upcoming server documentation to host their entire corporate communication infrastructure internally.

useCases.title: Experimental Feature Testing
useCases.description: Power users download the Canary client to test out the newly overhauled video conferencing system before organizing a large community event.

useCases.title: Gaming Voice Chat
useCases.description: Gaming groups utilize the low-latency VoIP channels to coordinate strategies during gameplay without relying on proprietary commercial platforms.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Fluxer is targeted at community managers, privacy advocates, and gaming groups seeking a modern, self-hostable alternative to proprietary voice and text platforms.
